initial_function_limitation: This precision hypothesis changes only the training hidden-feature quantizer, including at initialization. The independent rank1 nonlinear function and fixed evaluation precision remain original; no initial training output equivalence is claimed.
oracle: Independent Torch joint coefficient packing, original FP16 rounding stages without hidden GS32, smooth FP32 STE autograd and grouped FP32 matrix products with BF16 storage.
tolerance_scope: FP16/BLAS reduction and BF16 storage included in forward/input/weight bounds; smooth gradients below3e-5 relativeRMS. All evaluation values and gradients require bitwise equality.
decision: Launch the bounded actual-model speed/state gate. Require both original prefixes strictly faster, full24graphwarmup, evaluation oracle, normal/pending restoration and bitwise next-update parity before discovery.
